title: Connection Request
content: Build connection request component. Request card: avatar, name, mutual connections, message if included. Actions: Accept and Decline buttons. Preview: brief profile preview. Request list: pending requests with count badge. Sent requests: view pending outgoing requests. Suggestions: "People you may know" below requests.

variants.simple: Create connection/friend request notification with actions.
variants.detailed: Build connection request component. Request card: avatar, name, mutual connections, message if included. Actions: Accept and Decline buttons. Preview: brief profile preview. Request list: pending requests with count badge. Sent requests: view pending outgoing requests. Suggestions: "People you may know" below requests.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive connection/friend request system UI. Request notification card: bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm p-4 border. Layout: flex gap-3. Avatar: w-14 h-14 rounded-full, click previews profile. Content: flex-1. Name: font-semibold, verified badge if applicable, click to profile. Username: text-gray-500 text-sm. Mutual connections: text-sm text-gray-600 "8 mutual friends" with tiny avatar stack, or "Works at [Company]" context. Request message: if included, text-sm italic text-gray-600 in quotes, line-clamp-2 with expand. Sent time: text-xs text-gray-400 "2 days ago". Action buttons: flex gap-2 mt-3. Accept/Confirm: bg-blue-500 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg. Decline/Delete: text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg, or just X button. Confirmation: brief success animation on accept, card removes with animation on decline. Quick actions: accept without opening card via checkmark button. Pending requests page: header with count "Friend Requests (12)", tabs or sections for Received and Sent. Received list: cards as described above, infinite scroll if many. Sent requests: similar cards but with "Pending" status and "Cancel Request" option. Request settings: "Who can send you requests" link to privacy settings. Bulk actions: "Accept All" for trusted sources (e.g., from contacts). Request expiration: old requests auto-expire or show "Expired" state. Request from notification: push notification "[Name] sent you a friend request" with Accept/View actions. Profile integration: "Add Friend" button state changes to "Request Sent" then "Friends". Cancel sent request: from profile or sent requests list. Connection suggestions: "People You May Know" section below requests, similar cards with "Add Friend" instead of Accept/Decline. Request message: option to include message when sending request. Follow vs friend: if platform has both, UI distinguishes (Follow is one-way, Friend is mutual). Rate limiting: prevent spam requests, "You've sent too many requests" warning. Accessibility: request actions clearly labeled with user name, status changes announced, keyboard navigable.
